data analysis, especially for quantum data, with applications for quantum materials, biochemistry and high-energy physics. Nevertheless, challenges remain regarding the trainability of quantum machine learning models. Here we review current meth-
ods and applications for quantum machine learning. We highlight differences between quantum and classical machine learning,
